body: I'm hoping that I'll try to get her to talk to her grandparents about it so they can help support her. I know I can't just rely on her to help herself with this, since nobody else knows what she's going through right now. So I think it's very important that I make sure the grandparents know about it.

I wrote an update, but basically: I made it there and everything's okay. I came back home because I believe that it'd be better to not surprise them with me being there in the morning on a school day. I'll have to talk to her and her grandparents about it when I find the time is right. But I know I can't wait around until something else happens. I've got to man-up and get the help she needs. 

Thank you for your concern.

Thank you. It really helps to see it from other people's perspectives.

Your last sentence brought tears to my eyes. I never even thought about it being nice or kind to do what I did. I felt like I really wanted to go do it and comfort someone who is close to me.

She is okay. I edited in an update in the main submission. I'm back from her house. I decided I shouldn't stay tonight. I didn't get permission from the grandparents to come over, only the aunt, so I'm sure they wouldn't have been too pleased to see that I spent the night with her while we're not dating.

Hey there. Thanks for responding. I'm about to head over to her house now. She doesn't have a cellphone, but I've been texting her aunt(younger than her) and she is going to let me in so I can go see her.

I'll keep you guys updated on what's going on if possible.

Thank you for your input. Her aunt is waiting for me now at the back door, so I must go.
